country.description: The country it comes from, as a two-letter code (de), or EUROPE for the EU institutions and Europe-wide catalogues.

country_name.description: The country's name, such as Germany.

description.description: The start of its description (about 300 characters) in the chosen language. 'Get a dataset' gives it in full.

distribution_count.description: How many distributions (files or services) it has.

formats.description: The file formats of its distributions, such as CSV or Excel XLSX.

id.description: The dataset's id on data.europa.eu, which 'Get a dataset' and 'List a dataset's distributions' take.

is_high_value.description: True when it is one of the EU's high-value datasets, which public bodies must publish free and machine-readable.

issued.description: When the publisher first released it: a date (YYYY-MM-DD) or a UTC time.

keywords.description: Its keywords: those in the chosen language when it has any, else all of them.

language.description: The language the title and description are in (en, de...): the one asked for when the portal has it, else English, else the publisher's own.

licences.description: Every licence its distributions are released under, each once. The data is reused under these terms; 'Get licence terms' says what each allows.

id.description: The licence as the publisher gives it: a code from the EU licence list (CC_BY_4_0) or a link.

name.description: The licence's name, such as Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International, when the record or the EU list gives one.

modified.description: When the publisher last changed it: a date (YYYY-MM-DD) or a UTC time.

quality_score.description: The portal's metadata quality score for the record (higher is better), when it has been assessed.

themes.description: The EU data themes it is filed under.

code.description: The theme's code, such as ENVI.

name.description: The theme's name in the chosen language, such as Environment.

title.description: The dataset's title in the chosen language.

url.description: The dataset's page on data.europa.eu, in the chosen language.

has_more.description: True when there is another page (within the first 10,000 matches).

language.description: The language titles and descriptions were asked for.

limit.description: How many datasets a page holds.

total.description: How many datasets match in all.

description: Search and read data.europa.eu, the European Union's official open data portal: about 1.9 million datasets from the EU institutions and the national, regional and geospatial portals of 36 countries, in every EU language. Find datasets by words, country, catalogue, theme, format, licence or date, read one in full with its download links and licences, see what was added lately or get a workflow run when a new dataset appears, break datasets down by format or licence, and check a catalogue's metadata quality or what a licence allows. No account or API key required.

data_europa_new_dataset_trigger.description: Runs when data.europa.eu adds a dataset in a catalogue, from a country, under a data theme or matching search words, with its title, description, publisher, formats, licences and link. Datasets already there when the workflow is turned on don't run it.

parameters.description: Words a new dataset must match, in its title, description or keywords, such as 'air quality'. Give these, a catalogue, a country, a theme, or any mix of them.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: Only datasets from this catalogue, such as Eurostat or a national portal. Leave blank for every catalogue.
parameters.name: catalogue

parameters.description: Only datasets from this country's catalogues; EUROPE means the EU institutions. Leave blank for every country.
parameters.name: country

parameters.description: Only datasets filed under this EU data theme, such as Environment. Leave blank for every theme.
parameters.name: theme

parameters.description: The language for each dataset's title, description and themes. Leave blank for English.
parameters.name: language
